card.name: Foreign-language words in bibliography citations
card.fires_on: Words or word parts in non-English (German, French, Spanish, Malay, Latin) titles and phrases, often inside academic reference lists. It fires on a small linking word or a partway piece of a word that is followed by more of the foreign title.

modes.label: Foreign titles in citations
modes.description: Partway through or just before the next word of a non-English book or article title in a reference.
modes.example: Wege einer ant<<ir>>assistischen Anthropologie, Wien, L

modes.label: Small linking words in titles
modes.description: A short word such as d', e, or Die joining parts of a foreign-language title.
modes.example: WADDINGTON, Inscriptions de Grece et<< d>>'Asie-Mineure, n

modes.label: Other foreign prose
modes.description: Spanish or Malay running text where a word is split or about to continue.
modes.example: sebagai Malaysia. Ini membawa erti bahawa semua kepualaun ini adalah merupakan satu negara sebelum dipecah-pecahkan<< oleh>> barat.

card.plain: It lights up on non-English words inside titles and references, where the next word of the title is still to come.
